short_desc.en: Puts your apps on your tailnet automatically.
short_desc.pt: Coloca os seus apps na sua tailnet automaticamente.

description.en: Publishes containers on the tailnet automatically, from labels alone — no per-service proxy configuration
description.pt: Publica containers na tailnet automaticamente, só com labels — sem configurar proxy manualmente por serviço

secrets.authkey: manual a REUSABLE auth key from https://login.tailscale.com/admin/settings/keys (one-off does not work: tsdproxy registers a node per proxy, and the check below spends one use)

validate.authkey: shell podman run --rm -i --entrypoint /bin/sh docker.io/tailscale/tailscale:v1.102.3 -c 'k=$(cat); tailscaled --tun=userspace-networking --state=mem: >/dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 4; tailscale up --authkey="$k" --hostname=qh-keycheck --accept-dns=false || exit 1; tailscale logout || true'

hint.en: A reusable key from the Tailscale admin (or a Headscale pre-auth key).
hint.pt: Uma chave reutilizável do admin do Tailscale (ou uma chave de pré-autenticação do Headscale).
